name: handbuilt-church-labs
description: Church workspace setup, weekly bulletins, sermon research and reflection, sermon videos, monthly finance reports, and a church brand system.

interface.shortDescription: Weekly church writing and worship workflows
interface.longDescription: Create a private church folder, prepare source-verified sermon research briefs, write your sermon in your own voice with a light edit, prepare the recorded sermon as a reviewable video, produce reviewable worship bulletin booklets, build a monthly finance report for the vestry or council from QuickBooks, and design your church's brand system with the reasoning taught as each decision is made.
